result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The change is in `DataStore.java`, in `countPurchaseOrdersIntoSalesRepRegionsPerSalesRep`. I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the subquery, the same condition the per-quarter report uses. I also updated that method's Javadoc to say cancelled orders are not counted.

In `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest`, I added a regression test, `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`, that reproduces your Anna/Bob example and expects `Anna:2, Bob:1`. I gave the test helper a status-taking overload so the test can create cancelled orders; existing calls are unchanged.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests, 0 failures). I didn't re-run the new test against the unfixed code to confirm it fails there. Nothing is committed.
